ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality (colored by Stress, sized by Activity)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1)
cbar.set_label('Stress Level', fontsize=9)

# 2. Physical Activity vs Daily Steps (bar plot)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
occupations = df['Occupation'].unique()

steps_by_occ = [df[df['Occupation'] == occ]['Daily Steps'].mean() for occ in occupations]

x = np.arange(len(occupations))
width = 0.35

ax2.set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=10)

ax2.set_title('Activity Levels by Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticks(x)
ax2.set_xticklabels(occupations, rotation=15, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax2.legend(fontsize=9)

# 3. BMI Distribution (pie chart)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors,
                                   textprops={'fontsize': 9})
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Blood Pressure Analysis (box plot)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
bp_data = [df['Systolic BP'], df['Diastolic BP']]

    patch.set_facecolor(color)
ax4.set_ylabel('Blood Pressure (mmHg)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Blood Pressure Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Heart Rate vs Age (line plot with markers)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
for occupation in df['Occupation'].unique():

ax5.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate by Age and Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend(fontsize=9)
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

ax6.set_xlabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Stress Level Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xticks(stress_counts.index)

corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()

                      ax=ax7, annot_kws={'fontsize': 8})
ax7.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.setp(ax7.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
plt.setp(ax7.get_yticklabels(), fontsize=9)

# Add sleep disorder indicator
sleep_disorder_present = df['Sleep Disorder'].apply(lambda x: x != '')
if sleep_disorder_present.any():
    disorder_info = df[sleep_disorder_present][['Occupation', 'Sleep Disorder']].drop_duplicates()
    disorder_text = "Sleep Disorders Present:\n" + "\n".join([f"{row['Occupation']}: {row['Sleep Disorder']}" 
                                                             for _, row in disorder_info.iterrows()])
    fig.text(0.02, 0.02, disorder_text, fontsize=9, verticalalignment='bottom',

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
